scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-size bijection, generating-function mean and algebraic sign proof; exact finite computer enumerations are separate checks, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: The exact size-biased identity requires uniform rooted binary non-plane leaf-labeled phylogenetic trees (PDA). It is not a Yule/Kingman statement and does not establish any joint central limit theorem, negative association, or other stochastic ordering. Earlier equivalent identities may remain undiscovered.
title: Cherry-biased pruning and exact Sackin covariance in uniform phylogenetic trees
